study.title: Upland rice multi-environment trials in the Highlands and Mid-West of Madagascar, 2022-2025
study.description: Upland rice multi-environment trials of the FOFIFA-CIRAD breeding programme in farmers' fields of the Highlands and Mid-West of Madagascar, over the 2022-2023, 2023-2024 and 2024-2025 rainy seasons, under the DINAAMICC and MAKIS projects and partner networks. 370 environment-seasons in six regions (Analamanga, Amoron'i Mania, Bongolava, Haute Matsiatra, Itasy, Vakinankaratra) hosted by 191 farmer codes, testing 23 varieties: Chhomrong Dhan, FOFIFA varieties, NERICA 4, 10 and 14, Primavera, Sebota 410 and five SCRID release candidates. 285 sites have plot measurements (4 to 21 plots, one or two replicates, row and column layout): phenology dates, plot grain weight and yield, hills harvested, a 1 m2 yield sample from 2024-2025 and a sparse visual score. At every site the farmer ranked the varieties for seven criteria, choosing the first three and leaving the others at rank 4. Field, soil, fertilizer and household descriptors come from the trial description table. Parentage of every variety is in metadata.genotypes. Republished from the CIRAD Dataverse record https://doi.org/10.18167/DVN1/XKQ9SX (version 1, CC BY 4.0), released here under CC0 1.0 with the permission of CIRAD.

design.layout: rows and columns recorded for every plot
design.ranking: farmer chose the three most preferred varieties per criterion; all other varieties present take rank 4

study.consistency_warning: Ranks are not tricot triads. Rank 4 groups every variety present but not chosen and orders none of them; treat the ranks as top-three choices with a tied remainder. yield_from_sample is a 1 m2 estimate and does not replace yield.

location_privacy.method: The data producer displaced coordinates by less than 1 km, year of birth by up to 2 years and farm area by less than 1 are, with a fixed seed and the same value for a farmer across seasons, and removed farmer names. Site coordinates are then rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within about 1.8 km of the field.
location_privacy.admin_names: Region, district and commune kept as recorded, with the former province derived from the region

genotypes.breeding_programme: Landrace introduced from Nepal in the early 1990s
genotypes.remarks: Traditional irrigated variety of Nepal, introduced to Madagascar in the early 1990s and the most widely grown upland rice of the Highlands. The partner gives 1995 as the registration year; the FOFIFA catalogue in the 2021-2022 campaign report and Raboin et al. (2014) give release in 2006. Red pericarp.

variables.description: Site identifier, trial id plus the environment-season code of the source (ENV_ID, with / written _)
Trial identifier, 11 hex characters of the MD5 hash of country code and trial code plus 'v'
Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code
Country name
Crop tested in the trial
Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals from a point the data producer had already displaced by less than 1 km
Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals from a point the data producer had already displaced by less than 1 km
Where the original coordinate was taken. Some farms were recorded by GPS, others located at the village (fokontany); the source does not say which
Radius in metres around the published point that contains the recorded point (producer jitter under 1 km plus rounding)
Check of the coordinate against the extent of the country (ok, outside)
Former province (faritany), from the region
Region (faritra)
District
Commune
Environment-season code of the source, the key of the deposited tables
Trial and farmer code across seasons (trial group plus number; a suffix b marks a new farmer on the same number). Not a personal identifier

Project or partner network that hosted the site, from the second part of trial_group (DINAAMICC, MAKIS; CEF, GSDM and AGSU as coded)
Growing season, sowing in the first year and harvest in the second
Gender of the host farmer
Year of birth of the host farmer, displaced by up to 2 years by the data producer

Soil fertility as perceived by the farmer, 2024-2025 only, not a laboratory measure
Site identifier, links to site_data
Plot identifier of the source (PLOT) for measured traits; the code of the variety for preference ranks, which refer to the variety in the field and not to one plot
Variety in the plot, links to metadata.genotypes; null where the ranking record has no variety

Date of the observation where the source records it

Identifier of the harmonised question

Value as text; numbers in the unit given in 'unit'
rank, numeric or date
